description: According to The Times of India, the higher education department, MoE, is all set to execute a centre of excellence on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in a state public university with an aim to develop cutting-edge AI solutions in the country.
body_lead: Results for " According to The Times of India, the higher education department, MoE, is all set to execute a centre of excellence on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in a state public university with an aim to develop cutting-edge AI solutions in the country. The plans regarding the centre were discussed with Rama Devi Women’s University on Friday.
